notes.title: An update has arrived for Tyrgard
notes.content:
[h2]Hello fellow archers.[/h2]

During the summer we have been working on some updates and bug fixes for Tyrgard

[h3]We have added a barn and a practice range[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100240/fd251352b9f926c29f7b11f399e06cf4ccc2cf78.png[/img]

[list]
[*] The barn is where you grab your bow and shoot the targets hiding. It is a time based game mode that starts when you pull down the lever. 
[*] a standard practice range. You can turn the wheel to decide how far the target should be out. if you pull the lever it activates the hiscores and you'll be given 10 arrows. The further out the target is the higher score it will award you when hitting the bullseye. Now go claim your spot on the leaderboard!
[/list]

The annoying 1+ enemies remaining should now have been fixed along with other minor bugs.

notes.title: Minor game update, Exit button!
notes.content: Just a minor update, With Tyrgaard we have always been focusing more on the gameplay than the game menu and how to exit the game. Hence having no in-game way to exit without Alt+F4. this has now changed. We still don't want to split the focus from the gameplay but we have seen a few bugs where the game closes, but Steam still thinks it is open. So now you can exit the game using the escape button.

tags.feature: So now you can exit the game using the escape button.

notes.title: Long waited news has arrived at Tyrgard!
notes.content:
Due to the covid-19 situation, we have been under pressure. and we haven't had enough time working on our new title and Tyrgard. But we finally have some news for you guys here in the realm of Tyrgard.

[list]
[*] high scores
[*] Performance updates
[/list]


First of we have implemented a global steam high score and replaced the old local high scores that you saw in the game. this should add some competition between you and your friends. Currently, the leaderboards are available at steam, in-game it only shows the #1 by score, but in near future, we plan to have an in-game leaderboard ready to display friends or global leaderboard.

Secondly, we have tweaked the code a bit and pushed for slightly better performance


We wish you the best, and let us see who shall become the number 1 archer in the realm of Tyrgard!

notes.title: Ambidextrous bow & visual update.
notes.content:
Hello fellow viking archer badasses!

We have officially updated the game with a new bow, that can be used in any hand! Not only that but we have also changed the visuals for more color and clear vision!

Updated Bow

The bow can now be used in either hand. Just use the grab trigger to pick it up! Want to change hands, well just grab it with the other hand to switch it over. No need to hold the grab trigger down, just press it once to keep it in that hand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100240/d1aacef8c271a7bf1daf0dfc9f71e26233ee78af.gif[/img]


More weight and feedback.

We have added a more realistic gravity pull to the arrow, giving it more weight and feeling of being real. This also makes those charged precise shots feel more worth it for those long range hits.
The bow now also feels more real to interact with through haptic feedback.

Visual update

We have updated the levels visuals, as well as the arrow trail, and explosive effects of frost arrow and explosive arrow.



That's all for now, but we are still working on improving the game, and more will come!

If you have any feedback then let us know at info@actura-studios.com!

So long!
- The dev team

notes.title: Future plans
notes.content:
Hello Honorable vikings!

A quick update on what we are currently working on!


[h2]Current progress[/h2]

[h3]Ambi bow handling[/h3]
Currently our main focus has been on supporting the use of either hand, when holding the bow. We have come very far and expect to have it ready and implemented at the end of this week. (31/07)
We have also added more feedback to the bow and weight through vibrations and a more convincing arrow drop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100240/d1aacef8c271a7bf1daf0dfc9f71e26233ee78af.gif[/img]

[h3]Visual update[/h3]
We got alot of feedback regarding the visuals of the level being very orange tinted, making it hard to discern the enemies from the background. So we have brightened up, and brought more color to the scene, so it should now be much easier to spot those nasty dragon whelps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100240/bee5750297f1580bdc0a232f48b282dac3727841.png[/img]

[h2]Future plans[/h2]

[h3]Difficulty & scaling[/h3]
Some of the feedback we are getting involves the difficulty hitting too hard too soon. So we are looking into spreading out the difficulty a bit more to give new players a chance to get a feeling for the game and mechanics. Since multiple waves can be started quickly in succession by the player, these changes won't affect the pacing of the game.

[h3]Thoughts & ideas[/h3]
We have some more ideas for the future in the form of, fun game modes, more advanced enemies, boss types, environmental effects & levels!
We are constantly looking for feedback and ideas from the community, so if you have some ideas or wishes for the game, please feel free to let us know, and maybe it might just be done!



Best regards
- The dev team
